posts.en:
voco-input-sh is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Voice input for the Web UI: a mic button that drives local VocoType offline speech recognition and auto-inserts recognized text into the composer (auto-deploy, dedupe, continuous dictation).

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-7a03bf2b20cd0fd40250.html
